John Danaher - collection 480p/Feet To F.overview: John Danaher's three-part standing course for jiu-jitsu (24 videos, about 39 hours), stored here as three subfolders. Volume 1 (Fundamental Standing Skills) covers stance and movement, grip fighting, front takedowns, the ankle pick, snap downs, takedowns for self-defence and a special study of the high single leg. Volume 2 covers judo for jiu-jitsu, mostly in the gi: a simplified theory of gripping, sasae tsuri komi ashi, the big leg throws (ouchi gari and others), sacrifice throws (yoko and front tomoe nage) and a long section on sumi gaeshi, which he argues is the best throw for jiu-jitsu. Volume 3 covers guard pulling done properly (pulling to a sweep, to an advantage, to a position, to a submission), takedown counters, step-around counters and mat returns.
John Danaher - collection 480p/Feet To F.for: Jiu-jitsu players who want a complete, safe standing game, gi or no-gi.
key: Ankle pick, snap downs and high single
Judo throws for jiu-jitsu: tomoe nage, sumi gaeshi

John Danaher - collection 480p/Go Furthe.overview: John Danaher's gi guard retention fundamentals, eight volumes. Volume 1 is the overview. Volume 2 covers the big-picture theory and the two most basic requirements. Volume 3 covers the first skill, movement, especially from the seated position. Volume 4 covers the second skill, framing. Volume 5 covers connection, and the five things an opponent needs to pass your guard. Volumes 6 to 8 apply the theory to specific passes: the double under, the toreando and the leg drag.
John Danaher - collection 480p/Go Furthe.for: Gi players at any level who get passed.
key: Retaining against double under, toreando and leg drag
